svg.text: The cross product turns area into a vector

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In 2D it is a signed area; in 3D it is perpendicular to the plane spanned by the inputs, with length equal to the area

svg.text: The 2D cross product is just a number: the signed area of the parallelogram spanned by the two vectors, with sign set by orientation.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 3D cross product packs that area into a vector: length equals area, direction is perpendicular to the plane, and the right-hand rule fixes the sign.
